system.description:
The mage creates a thin bond of death between a corpse and Dimhall that permits the mage to speak with the spirit of the corpse. However, the spirit can choose whether to converse with the mage or not. Because it is an incredibly hard task to find the spirit of the corpse in Dimhall, the enchanter is not always certain that the spell has succeeded, even if the bond is created. Mages who use this spell have to be wary of the risks that are associated with creating a bond of death.
